# CameraPushState (push)

Camera identity and connection state from GetPushStateInfo. This is not a video-format message. Callers must validate sender/index and packet direction.

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** Classic DJI GO 3.1.8 DataCameraGetPushStateInfo getConnectState (offset 0 bit 0), getCameraType (33), getVerstion (36). FC300X=4. Seven identical 37-byte pushes in captures/sessions/2026-10-23/aoa_relay_server.log. See docs/camera-video-push.md.
